production_import_policy: Authored core inputs only; frozen Git objects are migration/test witnesses, never runtime fallback

features.name: gametest_sides
features.behaviour: Physical-distribution metadata defaults to both distributions; filter annotated definitions before class loading only. Generated definitions retain original discovery.

features.name: gametest_static_names
features.behaviour: Expose static testNameFor(Class) and retain instance testName results.

features.name: client_properties
features.behaviour: Use the common typed SFMProperties property accessors and run-mode type, rather than raw system property access. No implicit smoke, puppet, pause or delay changes.
missing_closure: property-specific SFMTitleScreenDevScreen/SFMGameTestId consumers must retain independent ownership

features.name: game_puppet_runtime
features.behaviour: Route GAME_PUPPET title/tick/pause events to SFMGamePuppetHarness; preserve ordinary client GameTests as a separate path.

features.name: client_smoke_harness
features.behaviour: Move SMOKE completion out of GameTest Harness and into the separate SFMClientSmokeRunHarness.

features.name: client_automation_pause_restore
features.behaviour: Capture/restore pause-on-lost-focus without options.save; restrict normal puppet pause suppression to active automation and mark completion when scheduling exit.

features.name: client_automation_keep_open_default
features.behaviour: Raise default post-test keep-open countdown from10 to25 seconds independently of property registry.

features.name: client_automation_registry_copy
features.behaviour: Acquire RegistryAccess.builtinCopy for new test-world creation instead of the released BUILTIN frozen reference.

features.name: client_automation_harness_annotations
features.behaviour: Preserve developer Nullable tracker metadata, plus the witnessed1.19.4 world-create MCVersionDependentBehaviour annotation; no runtime access expansion.

features.name: gametest_mekanism_dependency_isolation
features.behaviour: Remove embedded Mekanism imports and preparation helpers. Preserve them off for released API compatibility; do not silently repair remaining compatibility consumers.
missing_closure: Modern frozen dev compatibility test sources still call helper.getAndPrepMekTile; these consumers need a separately reviewed helper/migration before enabled build acceptance.

features.name: command_history
features.behaviour: Use an in-memory command history during normal test or game-puppet automation; no disk/history isolation during manual gameplay.
